author: Al3cs
text: Obviously was a DBR - Drop Base Rally and not RBD, excuse me for the mistake. I think that you must look HTFs (daily in this chart) for setups and go down in LTF for pinpoint the entry. So the DBR in the daily is enough. Every DBR in LTF could contain different DBR with RBR and/or RBD. This is the reason why the first HW assigned is the one inherent caps on price. You must walk on this stair step by step.

author: omidfxt
text: hey staurum well done man, good start with QM look for QMs as you want to trade them where do you look for them? draw your zones in HTF and go to LTF and see the reactions the shape itself isn't rally important, try to understand the concept behind it for example in an up trend, when price approach your zone and flaged, did the LL engulf the important FL there or just engulf a less important low there? it can cause your QM fail and a Diamond create, you will get better each time you look for them and i suggest you that don't draw that lines on your QMs, they are not clear enough to investigate them keep the good work doing regards
